newsitem.title: BRAZIL: CVRD injunctions keep coming - Brazil govt.
newsitem.headline: CVRD injunctions keep coming - Brazil govt.

text.p: New injunctions are still being filed against the privatization of Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), making any prediction as to the timing of the sell-off impossible, a senior government official said.

"Yesterday there were 21 (injunctions). We overturned 19 and two were left. Today there must be a whole lot more," Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros, president of the National Development Bank (BNDES) told reporters.
The BNDES was forced to call off Tuesday's scheduled auction of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares because of the injunctions blocking the sale.
Mendonca de Barros said he could not confirm the auction would go ahead Wednesday as previously hoped by BNDES officials.
"I'm not going to risk any (prediction of a) new date. It's up to the courts," he told reporters during a ceremony at the presidential palace.

Government lawyers were waiting for a verdict from a judge at the Superior Justice Tribunal (STJ), Brazil's highest court for non-constitutional matters, on a case which seeks to group in one court all injunctions brought against the privatization.
The measure would make it easier for the Brazilian government to deal with the injunctions.
